content.short: Etherspot TransactionKit is a React library for fast Web3 development.
content.description: Etherspot TransactionKit is a React library that streamlines Web3 development and transaction handling across Ethereum and a broad set of Ethereum-compatible networks. You don’t need deep blockchain expertise to write code that executes transactions on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Celo, Moonbeam, Fantom, OP Mainnet, Multichain, and other supported chains. By integrating this kit, you can add robust transaction capabilities to your dapp quickly and with minimal boilerplate, enabling smoother cross-chain experiences for users.
